<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0"><B>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0"><B>OF CERTIFICATE OF
INCORPORATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0"><B>OF &nbsp;VG &nbsp;LIFE SCIENCES
INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>



<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-indent: 20pt">VG Life Sciences, Inc., a corporation organized and existing under and by virtue of the General
Corporation Law of the State of Delaware (the &ldquo;Corporation&rdquo;) does hereby certify that:</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>FIRST:&nbsp;</B>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;That at a meeting of the Board of Directors of the
Corporation, resolutions were duly adopted setting forth a proposed amendment of the Corporation&rsquo;s Certificate of Incorporation,
declaring said amendment to be advisable and calling a meeting of the stockholders of the Corporation for consideration thereof.
The resolution setting forth the proposed amendment is as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>RESOLVED</B>, that the Certificate of Incorporation of this Corporation be amended by striking the Article
thereof numbered &ldquo;FOURTH&rdquo; in its entirety and replacing said Article so that, as amended, it shall be and read as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 40pt">&ldquo;FOURTH.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Effective for accounting purposes on December
31,2013, (the &ldquo;Effective Time&rdquo;),</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 40pt; text-indent: 20pt">the Company shall be authorized to issue two classes of shares of stock to be designated,
respectively, &ldquo;Preferred Stock&rdquo; and &ldquo;Common Stock&rdquo;; the total number of shares of stock which the
Company shall have authority to issue shall be One Hundred and Sixty million (160,000,000); the total number of shares of
Common Stock which the Company shall have authority to issue shall be One Hundred and Fifty Million (150,000,000) with a par
value of One Hundredth of One Cent($0.0001); the total number of shares of Preferred Stock which the Company shall have
authority to issue shall be Ten Million(10,000,000) with a par value of One Hundredth of a Cent ($0.0001).</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>SECOND:&nbsp;</B>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;That thereafter, pursuant to resolution of
its Board of Directors, a special meeting of the stockholders of the Corporation was duly called and held upon notice in accordance
with Section 228 of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware at which meeting the necessary number of shares as required
by statute were voted in favor of the amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>THIRD:</B>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;That said amendment was duly adopted
in accordance with the provisions of Section 242 of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware.</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>
